expectedResult: Input beyond the supported 1000-character limit is rejected safely and no truncated or partial comment is stored.
actualResult: A 1006-character controlled comment was accepted with 'Comment posted' and remained listed after reload instead of being rejected. The UI collapses it behind MORE, so the boundary contract is violated.
reviewBoundary: Current-runtime candidate defect; DonHV must review and route product ownership before approved FAIL.

Oversized comment remains listed after reload.

limitations: The collapsed UI does not expose the complete stored value without opening MORE; acceptance and post-reload presence are sufficient to prove rejection did not occur.
